source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Fill in inspection report fields, use the following method and format. 3. Compare data against standards and apply a FAIL to the test record. 4. Move on to the next test in series of tests for failure code. ## 1. Data format - test results using type 2 inspection stations Examine the recorded inspection results for the different brake test types. The following data formats should be used. Note: These formats only apply to stations conducting type 2 inspections. Brake test type | Test standards \\ :--------------: | :----------------: | Parking Brake| Parking brake lbs (lb)| Service Brake| Front lbs (lb)| Service Brake| Rear lbs (lb)| Roller Brake| N/A| De-accelerometer| If less than 13.968mph - PASS,

more than 13.968 mph
